source_shape: Both16x24native variants have broad irregular greasy-leaf crowns, crooked visible brown branches/trunk and a wide exposed root nest. Variant1leans its crown toward the upper right with a low left lobe; variant2has a higher central lobe and a lower right-spreading crown.

palette.rule: Foliage is source primary; exposed trunk/branches/roots are source detail. Neutral albedo and independent wood tint mask must be extracted after refinement.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed oak replacement supplies readable clustered leaf masses, dark game-art contours and restrained tree shading only. It is not a dogthorn species equivalent. Source root nest, thorns, branch visibility, two crown shapes and native G/w colors stay authoritative.

construction: Editable thorn-splintered crooked wood and tangled exposed roots under irregular clustered pointed leaves. Neutral gray foliage and brown wood during refinement explicitly identify tint ownership; final selected layers are entirely grayscale.
states: Two actual RandomTile builder choices: Terrain/sw_fattree1.bmp and Terrain/sw_fattree2.bmp. They are cosmetic fixed-map-view variants, not different ages/facings/races. Native instance selection remains source-owned.

frame.rule: One full-cell transform across both variants; no independent alpha-bound fit or new per-state root center.

native_behavior: Preserve source occlusion, plant/hanging support, inherited non-solid physics and native tile/random selection. Dense leaf art does not add collision or new growth behavior.
